page.content:
Warwickshire market town of Shakespeare's birth and retirement.

How Stratford-upon-Avon connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — Shakespeare was born, married, and buried in Stratford-upon-Avon.
  • Character: Anne Hathaway — Anne Hathaway kept the Stratford household.

What is Stratford-upon-Avon?

Stratford-upon-Avon is the town of Shakespeare's baptism, marriage to Anne Hathaway, property, and burial in Holy Trinity — the home pole opposite the Globe's London.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare and Anne Hathaway.
